model: EWWD-VZ / EWWH-VZ / EWWS-VZ water-cooled inverter screw chillers (Microtech, Adam software)
applies_to: EWWD-VZ, EWWH-VZ and EWWS-VZ water-cooled inverter screw chillers with Microtech III or Microtech 4 controller running Adam software, per D-EIGOC00201-22_03EN.
summary: Daikin Applied Europe's EWWD(H)(S)-VZ water-cooled inverter screw chillers expose a Modbus RTU slave on RS-485 through a POL902 module or, on Microtech 4, a licensed on-board option. All points are 16-bit holding registers covering unit and circuit status, evaporator and condenser water temperatures, refrigerant pressures, compressor current/power/VFD data, setpoints, pump states and individual alarm flags.

addressing.note: The guide's address column is headed (4xxxx): the column value 1 is holding register 40001 = wire address 0. Subtract 1 from the column value for the PDU address.

source.title: BAS integration guide - Modbus protocol, EWWD(H)(S)_VZ (Adam)
source.pages: POL902 setup p. 7; software option p. 8; integration list pp. 9-20; alarm codes from p. 21

notes: Addressing: the guide says every point is a holding register addressed as 4xxxx plus the number in its Address column, i.e. Modicon references (1 = 40001). On the wire that is the column value minus 1. Registers are listed here with that wire address; the documented field keeps the guide's column value.

Values are 16-bit words; 'Gain' is the multiplier (0.1 means tenths of a unit). Temperatures and pressures are shown in metric units; the 'Measurement unit setpoint' register (column 316) switches the unit system between English and Metric.
The Read/Write column only uses R and W; W points are taken as writable (and readable) and listed as RW.

Left out: every 'UNSIGNED DOUBLE' (32-bit) point (74-75 Circ 1 Compressor 1 - Number of Running Hours (32-bit); 113-114 Circ 2 Compressor 1 - Number of Running Hours (32-bit); 260-261 Performance - Unit Thermal Capacity (32-bit); 262-263 Performance - Unit Power Input (32-bit); 266-267 Performance - Unit Thermal Energy (32-bit); 268-269 Performance - Unit Electrical Energy (32-bit); 297 Condenser Pump 1 - Number of Running Hours (32-bit); 300-301 Condenser Pump 2 - Number of Running Hours (32-bit); 303-303 Evaporator Pump 1 - Number of Running Hours (32-bit); 306-307 Evaporator Pump 2 - Number of Running Hours (32-bit); 1900-1901 Unit - Active Energy (32-bit)). The guide does not say which word is high, and some address spans are misprinted, so they cannot be decoded safely from this document.
Left out: the alarm code/index table in section 5.1; the Warning/Problem/Fault Index and Code registers are listed, but their meanings need that table.
The 'Number of Tons' point (col 1857) is printed with unit kW; it is listed as printed.
Circuit 1 compressor VFD output (col 1845) is printed in Hz while circuit 2 (col 1805) is printed in %; both are listed as printed.

integration.summary: Read holding registers from wire address 0: Unit Status (col 15), evaporator leaving water (col 17) and capacity (col 13). Enable with col 9 and write the cooling setpoint to col 35 in tenths of °C.
integration.enable: Fit a POL902 module and set the Modbus parameters under Main menu > Commissioning > Modbus (service password); or on Microtech 4 turn on software option #1 'Modbus Slave MSTP' (unlock password needed) and set it under Commissioning > Commission Unit > SW Modbus MSTP.
quirks: Addresses are Modicon-style: subtract 1 from the guide's column value.
Several 0.1-gain values (capacity, temperatures, pressures) are signed words.
setup: POL902 module defaults: address 1, no parity, 2 stop bits, 19200 baud, 5 ms response delay.
Software-option defaults: 19200 baud, no parity, 1 stop bit, 100 ms delay and timeout.
gotchas: Running hours, energy and thermal capacity are 32-bit points with no stated word order; they are not in this map.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
